judge.rationale: The candidate invented its own frame names and types (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of using the ones explicitly specified in the issue (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It completely omitted the required `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, it directly violated a core acceptance criterion by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store does not implement `listFor`, whereas the ticket explicitly required returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame and never an empty list. It also failed to enforce the `limit` range of 1–200 (allowing 0 and >200), missed updating `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md`, and left a scratch `.lore/dod.md` file in the repository.
